title: KAMI: Communication-Avoiding General Matrix Multiplication within a Single GPU
problem: Large-scale GEMM near peak GPU performance, but substantial optimization opportunities remain in small and batched GEMM operations.
motivation: Communication-avoiding techniques can improve small/batched GEMM through better memory hierarchy utilization within GPU.
method: KAMI: 1D/2D/3D communication-avoiding GEMM algorithms optimizing at thread block level; utilizes tensor cores, thread registers, shared memory; includes SpMM and SpGEMM variants.
key_novelty: First GPU clock cycle-based analysis of communication-avoiding performance; unified framework for dense, low-rank, batched, and sparse multiplication.
contributions: Communication-avoiding GEMM algorithms (1D, 2D, 3D variants) for single GPU
Clock cycle-level performance analysis for GPUs
Support across NVIDIA, AMD, Intel GPUs

metrics.performance: significant improvement over cuBLAS, CUTLASS, MAGMA
